title: Clayton Christensen: Disruptive innovation
channel: Saïd Business School, University of Oxford
summary: Clayton Christensen explains his theory of disruptive innovation at Oxford's Said Business School, using examples from steel, Toyota, Sony, Walmart and Godrej. He applies the theory to why some economies stagnate and others grow.
why: HN uses it as a reference for disruption theory when explaining why incumbents like VW or BlackBerry decline.

quote.text: I believe VW is failing like this: (talk Disruptive innovation by Clayton Christensen).
